name: Dimitrios Papadopoulos
bio: Dimitrios's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, tinkering with his father's aging taxi fleet in Thessaloniki. His knack for optimizing routes and ensuring timely deliveries caught the attention of a local rally team needing logistical support. He quickly rose through the ranks, coordinating transport and supply chains for smaller racing outfits before landing a role with MP Motorsport. Dimitrios believes in meticulous planning and proactive problem-solving, ensuring every part arrives exactly where it's needed, when it's needed. His reputation for demanding excellence is matched by a genuine commitment to the team's success; he's a stickler for detail and isn't afraid to speak his mind to ensure the team operates at its peak efficiency.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Dimitrios is a man of medium build with a commanding presence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting everything.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his fingers on the table when under pressure.
Drinks copious amounts of strong Greek coffee throughout the day.
